subject: Outcome portfolio request for MerchantLift renewal
messages:
From: Jared Townes <jared@merchantlift.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@merchantlift.com
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Outcome portfolio request — MerchantLift renewal

Hi Olga,

We’re starting internal prep for our June renewal and the procurement team has asked for a short outcomes portfolio that explains the value Redwood has delivered over the last 12 months. Specifically they want:
- Latency and uptime improvements (before/after where possible)
- Aggregate cost per inference trends and any unit-cost reductions we can tie to batching/caching
- Adoption metrics (active users / queries per day / top routes)
- Any qualitative customer quotes or exec summary we can include for the board packet

Can you send a one‑page exec summary + a 2‑page evidence appendix by 5/5? If you already have a template or a short case study, that would be perfect.

Thanks — Jared
Jared Townes
Head of Platform Partnerships, MerchantLift
jared@merchantlift.com

--
Attachment (requested): list_of_metrics_template.xlsx (stub)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jared Townes <jared@merchantlift.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Outcome portfolio request — MerchantLift renewal

Thanks for the note, Jared — we can absolutely get that over. Quick clarifying Qs before we pull the pack:
1) Do you prefer absolute numbers or percent-change comparisons (we can include both, but procurement usually wants percent improvements)?
2) Should the adoption metrics be across all environments or just production traffic?
3) Any legal/comms constraints on sharing customer quotes tied to names/titles?

Plan: Ben (CS) will pull adoption and adoption-growth snapshots; Rishi will assemble perf charts and a 1‑page exec summary; I’ll combine and send a PDF + a short plain‑text quote you can paste into your board packet.

Target deliverable: MerchantLift_Outcome_Portfolio.pdf + supporting charts by 5/4 to give you time for internal review. If that timing doesn’t work, tell us and we’ll compress.

Olga Petrov

Hi Jared — attaching the deliverables for your procurement and board packet. Highlights up front:
- 12‑month uptime: 99.98% (regional failover events excluded)
- Median p95 latency (production): down from 420ms → 190ms after batch/caching optimizations (Dec ’26)
- Effective cost per inference: -23% year-over-year (batching + quantization suggestions applied in Q1)
- Adoption: 48k queries/day; 1.25k monthly active API keys; /generate-checkout-suggestions remains 52% of calls
- Business outcome called out by your analytics team: ~+3.1% conversion lift for users receiving Redwood suggestions (internal A/B).

Included in the PDF: 1‑page executive summary + 2‑page evidence appendix with time-series charts. Exec quote (cleared for attribution):
"Redwood’s inference improvements materially reduced latency and helped us ship higher-quality suggestions faster — the conversion lift has been measurable and sustained."
— Ana Rivas, Director of Product, MerchantLift

Files attached: MerchantLift_Outcome_Portfolio.pdf, merchantlift_perf_charts.png, exec_quote.txt

If procurement needs a doc-signed attestation or a short statement on data handling, loop in your legal and we’ll get a brief letter out same day. Also dropping a HubSpot link to the deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/MLFT-4821

Best,
